whenToUse: An app shell with a 60px icon rail whose icons open pinnable flyout navigation panels.
Content-heavy tools like a media library that need maximum canvas width.
avoidWhen: Few sections with labelled links — use shell-01.
Dense back-office module trees — use shell-06.
a11y: Rail buttons expose aria-expanded and aria-controls, the current item is aria-current, and floating panels close on Escape.
